stem.text: In the circuit shown, a fixed resistor X is connected in series with a battery and a variable resistor.

stem.alt: Circuit with a battery in series with a fixed resistor labelled X and a variable resistor.

stem.text: The power dissipated in resistor X is $7.2\,\text{W}$ when a current of $3.0\,\text{A}$ passes through it.
The variable resistor is adjusted so that the power dissipated in X increases by 50%.
What is the new current in the circuit?
